hooks.name: Frozen contract guard (agent edit)
hooks.description: When an agent file tool touches frontend/src/types/trace.ts, warn that the FROZEN shared contract changed, run npm run typecheck, and regenerate every fixture in shared/fixtures/ by running tracer.py in CPython (only if every trace has the fields trace.ts requires). Other edits pass through silently.

action.command: input=$(cat); echo "$input" | grep -Eq '(path|targetFile|sourcePath|destinationPath)\\?"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\?"[^"]*frontend/src/types/trace\.ts' || exit 0; root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; msg="WARNING: an agent edited frontend/src/types/trace.ts (the FROZEN shared contract). Only the integrator may change it. Review with: git diff -- frontend/src/types/trace.ts"; echo "$msg"; echo "$msg" >&2; cd "$root/frontend" || exit 1; fail=0; out=$(npm run typecheck 2>&1); code=$?; echo "$out" | tail -30; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then echo "typecheck FAILED (exit $code) after contract change" >&2; fail=1; else echo "typecheck passed"; fi; cd "$root" || exit 1; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then echo "fixture regen: .venv/bin/python not found. Create it with: uv venv .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements-dev.txt" >&2; exit 1; fi; gout=$(.venv/bin/python frontend/src/py/gen_fixtures.py --all 2>&1); gcode=$?; echo "$gout" | tail -20; if [ "$gcode" -ne 0 ]; then echo "fixture regeneration FAILED (exit $gcode); shared/fixtures/ left unchanged" >&2; fail=1; else echo "fixtures regenerated in shared/fixtures/ from tracer.py (CPython)"; fi; exit $fail
